title: Generic IND-qCPA to qIND-qCPA Transformation
summary: Block ciphers can be turned into qIND-qCPA-secure schemes, but whether every IND-qCPA-secure encryption scheme admits a generic upgrade remains open.

formal_statement.body: A construction is known that turns block ciphers into $\mathrm{qIND\text{-}qCPA}$-secure schemes. Determine whether there is a general patch that transforms any $\mathrm{IND\text{-}qCPA}$-secure encryption scheme into a $\mathrm{qIND\text{-}qCPA}$-secure encryption scheme, either by constructing such a patch or by establishing that none exists.

scope.domain: Generic security transformations for quantum-secure encryption schemes.
assumptions: The input encryption scheme is IND-qCPA-secure.
parameters: IND-qCPA-secure encryption scheme: arbitrary input to the proposed patch
qIND-qCPA security: required security guarantee for the transformed scheme
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a general patch transforming any IND-qCPA-secure encryption scheme into a qIND-qCPA-secure scheme, or establish that no such patch exists.

citations.label: Semantic Security and Indistinguishability in the Quantum World

progress.summary: The source reports a construction for turning block ciphers into qIND-qCPA-secure schemes and explicitly presents the existence of a general transformation for arbitrary IND-qCPA-secure schemes as a research question.
citation_labels: Tommaso Gagliardoni et al., Semantic Security and Indistinguishability in the Quantum World
